first_safe_milestone.description: Build the coordinator and run it in DRY_RUN=true/paper mode while the existing live v28 continues trading.
first_safe_milestone.name: paper_coordinator_replay
success_criteria: Produces two separate ledgers: v28-live-compatible decisions and dual-lane decisions.
Does not place orders or alter live bot state.
Matches existing live v28 entries closely enough to prove the coordinator observes the same market stream.
Shows dual-lane would have generated real-time actionable orders with no future-data dependencies.

go_no_go.required: One DRY_RUN=false process holds the lock and coordinates both lanes.
Dual-lane entry/exit rules run from current market/BTC/orderbook state only.
Every order has lane-specific strategy ID/client_order_id and a fill replay can score each lane separately.
Dual-lane size=1, configured max spend/loss, and operator-visible disable switch.
Broad dual-lane no longer trails live v28 or is explicitly limited to overlay/risk-control tests.

next_build_steps: Extract a side-effect-free v28 decision adapter from the current bot path for paper comparison.
Implement a side-effect-free dual-lane decision adapter from frozen observable rules only.
Add a coordinator ledger schema with lane, market, side, action, intended_qty, order_id, client_order_id, fill_qty, fill_price, fees, and exit link.
Run coordinator in paper mode against live market stream before enabling any dual-lane real orders.
Only after paper coordinator passes attribution/replay checks, add a single-process live flag for dual-lane size=1 under hard spend/loss caps.

recommended_architecture.must_not_do: Call post-hoc scorer rows that depend on settlement, reconstructed outcomes, or future exits.
recommended_architecture.purpose: Emit a real-time entry/exit decision from the frozen dual-lane rules without reading settled outcomes.

recommended_architecture.must_not_do: Start a second DRY_RUN=false bot process or bypass state/live_trading.lock.
recommended_architecture.purpose: Run v28 and dual-lane decision adapters in one process behind the existing live lock.

recommended_architecture.must_not_do: Infer attribution only from market ticker after both strategies can trade the same market.
recommended_architecture.purpose: Attribute each order, fill, exit, and settlement to v28 or dual-lane using explicit strategy IDs.

recommended_architecture.must_not_do: Allow two independent state machines to fight over the same account position.
recommended_architecture.purpose: Decide what happens when both strategies want the same market, same side, opposite side, or different sizes.

recommended_architecture.must_not_do: Let the test consume the whole account or assume v28 risk controls cover both strategies.
recommended_architecture.purpose: Enforce size=1 initial dual-lane trades, max open exposure, max daily spend/loss, and emergency disable.
